1_request_intent.description: Captures raw user intent, channel targets, and minimal preferences with idempotency token.
1_request_intent.missing_link_fixed: Legacy orchestrator required multi-turn confirmation phrases before producing; OAAS request contract allows direct autonomous single-turn execution.

2_structured_objective.description: Translates goal into target aspect ratio, duration, format, and planned execution steps.
2_structured_objective.missing_link_fixed: Replaces legacy manual aspect ratio & duration modal sliders with autonomous parameter resolution.

3_block_selection.description: Autonomously selects from 37 verified operable HyperFrames donor originals; rejects 159 unported & 2 retired blocks.
3_block_selection.missing_link_fixed: Prevented advertising unported or retired (creator-hud, glitch-transition) blocks as renderable.

4_project_persistence.description: Creates Project and ProjectRevision record in SQLite with document schema version 2.
4_project_persistence.missing_link_fixed: Connected autonomous outcome execution directly into versioned project tables.

5_video_rendering.description: Physical video rendering using local FFmpeg and Python imaging.
5_video_rendering.missing_link_fixed: Eliminated mock video descriptors; generates real decoded MP4 bytes on disk.

6_media_verification.description: Physical file size, SHA-256 computation, and deep ffprobe stream inspection.
6_media_verification.missing_link_fixed: Legacy system had no mandatory ffprobe decode gate before marking jobs complete.

7_library_persistence.description: Registers verified output in SQLite so it appears in the 6Clips Library workspace.
7_library_persistence.missing_link_fixed: Automated indexing without requiring manual 'Save to Library' user click.

8_approval_gate.description: Differentiates between standing authorization (direct delivery) vs manual review (NEEDS_APPROVAL).
8_approval_gate.missing_link_fixed: Prevents unauthorized external publication while enabling zero-click execution when pre-authorized.

9_distribution_handoff.description: Immutable handoff payload carrying render SHA-256, project ID, revision, and fail-closed credentials verification.
9_distribution_handoff.missing_link_fixed: Fail-closed truthfulness: marks PENDING_CREDENTIALS / NOT_CONNECTED instead of simulating uploads.
